reason: Root cause: customers.lookup@1 (src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs) read the legacy CRM nightly export via src/legacy/crm.mjs. That export is regenerated only once a day, so customers created by customers.register@1 were missing from it until the next export. customers.register@1 writes to src/store.mjs, which is the system of record for urn:example:customers:customer and is seeded from the same export at start-up. Fix: lookup now reads from the store with getCustomer and still raises NOT_FOUND for unknown ids. No contract, test or other module was changed. The verifier passed every check it reported: the contract digest is unchanged, outputs conform to their schemas, only the declared failure code occurs, and answers on existing state for customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1 are unchanged. customers.register@1 is now verified through its customer-readable state method, with its registered-event check not contradicted.

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
customers.register@1: declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) is not contradicted and every state method confirms
